plugins.name: oolio-pm
plugins.description: Oolio Product Management. The full PM toolkit, signal to shipped: feedback intake into JPD, idea grooming to Oolio's standards, PRD writing and grilling, validation via the Virtual Product Council and its hospitality personas, Jira hygiene, Steering packs, the GTM suite, metrics review, discovery maps for themes too big for one session, and the research house: HubSpot/web/Apify signal synthesis, competitor dossiers, sweeps and battlecards, win/loss mining, a daily HubSpot sweep that turns the support queue into cited Insights, one-off evidence attached as native JPD Insights, plus a compass that routes you to the right skill, drive, which turns a raw, rambling request into a finished result, and Roy the Behavioural Alchemist, the behavioural-economics lens, plus the Brain maintenance skills that keep the my_brain knowledge vault compounding, and push-to-brain, the explicit end-of-session push that lands what a session established on the page that already owns it. The QA family tests the built product before it ships: a test basis that lines up the sources and proves the metrics are measurable, functional, exploratory, design-conformance, WCAG 2.2 accessibility, synthetic-persona, code-coverage and resilience passes, real-user UAT, one defect standard that reworks stories before merge, and a release gate whose verdict hands GTM only verified claims and learns from what it missed. Forty-five skills.
